criteria.text: Anonymous protected and unknown routes do not allocate sessions; OIDC login, CSRF, session fixation protection and logout continue working; exercise repeated synthetic requests and record resource bounds.
Record sanitized test evidence and the tested revision, and update relevant documentation.

findings.summary: Evidence record names pre-squash branch commits (9d25605, 9d7fe68) as tested revisions, unreachable from the candidate head 341464a; its dev-stack resource tables were taken on 9d25605, before the expiry filter move and the start-time fix. AC2 is met in substance; traceability to the candidate is indirect.
findings.evidence: docs/verification/issue-311-anonymous-session-creation-verification.md (Environment, Review findings); `git diff --stat 9d7fe68 HEAD` in the candidate -> unknown revision

checks.environment: local, JDK 26.0.2, Testcontainers PostgreSQL, in-process OIDC provider stub
checks.summary: 129 tests, 0 failures: 38-request anonymous sweep (zero sessions, no JSESSIONID, statuses unchanged, raw health-check bytes), repeated-request pre-login expiry over GET/unsafe/webhook/repeated starts, login rotation and timeout reset, failed-callback cleanup; unchanged OidcBrowserSession (19) and BffTenantBoundary (8) suites cover login, CSRF, session fixation and logout.

checks.environment: local Docker, frontend image built from the candidate, no backend, loopback random port
checks.summary: 6 checks pass: 40 simultaneous login starts -> 11 passed on, 29 refused with 429, Retry-After: 2, text/plain, no cookie; /api/session and callback bursts get no 429.

Sanitized evidence record (counts, statuses, heap readings, no cookies or ids) with tested revisions; ADR 0007 section, security invariant 33, audit M2 status, infra README and application.yml updated consistently with the code.

checks.command: probe: disposable worktree copy (identity tree verified equal) + probes/A-H1/LoginStartPathVariantProbeTest.java; ./gradlew test --offline --tests '*LoginStartPathVariantProbeTest'
checks.summary: probe: raw-socket login-start path variants nginx proxies but does not key for the limit (/api/..;/oauth2/authorization/dokene and 4 others) all get 400 from the backend and create 0 sessions; sanity control: canonical /oauth2/authorization/dokene -> 302 and 1 session. Output in probes/A-H1/output.txt.

checks.command: negative control: disposable copy with probes/A-H2/negative-control.patch (PreLoginSessionExpiryFilter no longer invalidates); ./gradlew test --offline --tests '*PreLoginSessionExpiryIntegrationTest'
checks.summary: negative control: with the age check's invalidate removed, 4 of 5 PreLoginSessionExpiryIntegrationTest tests fail as intended, so the passing suite in C1 can detect a session kept alive past the pre-login timeout.
base control: not run because the probed protections (nginx login_starts limit, PreLoginSessionExpiryFilter) do not exist on the base, where every anonymous request already created a session.

limitations: The dev-stack evidence script scripts/verify-issue-311-anonymous-sessions.sh (2000-request sweep, heap readings) was not rerun: the Compose stack is off-limits for this verifier. Repeated synthetic requests on the candidate were exercised through the integration tests (C1) and the nginx smoke test (C2); resource bounds are taken from the recorded evidence, not re-measured.
No full ./gradlew check was run (budget rule: --tests filters only); WhatsAppWebhookIntegrationTest was not rerun.

Adversarial pass ran (triggers: Authorization, External integrations/OIDC). Hypotheses: H1 nginx limit-key bypass via path variants (C4, cleared, sanity-controlled); H2 pre-login age bound evaded across chains (C1 passed, C5 negative control); H3 login/CSRF/fixation/logout regression (cleared by unchanged OidcBrowserSessionIntegrationTest and BffTenantBoundarySecurityIntegrationTest in C1); H4 failed callback ends a signed-in session (only covered by the diff's own PreLoginSessionIntegrationTest, not negatively controlled); H5 direct backend-port bypass of the edge limit is a documented residual (ADR 0007), not raised. No pass findings; none restated F1.
Probe sources and redacted output kept under runs/311/probes/A-H1 and A-H2; the disposable worktree was removed.
